metadata.description: YouTube research skills for Claude Code, powered by Ozillo Studio data.

plugins.name: ozillo-youtube-research
plugins.description: 13 YouTube research skills on Ozillo Studio data: find, check, break down and bend niches; turn outlier videos into video ideas, titles, thumbnails and script templates; mine comments; break down, audit and watch channels and competitors; scout sponsors. Connects to the Ozillo Studio MCP server (an Ozillo Studio account with an active paid plan is required).
